faq_tests.question: Mere shohar ne talaq ka notice bheja hai, main kya karun?
Police mein FIR darj karane ka tarika kya hai?
Jaidat ki taqseem ke liye kya karna chahiye?

quality_tests.question: Tenant ko kese nikalein?
quality_tests.expected_answer: Tenant ko nikalne ke liye proper legal notice dena zaroori hai. Aapko Rent Controller ke paas application file karni hogi.
quality_tests.reference_answer: Tenant ko nikalne ke liye proper legal notice dena zaroori hai. Aapko Rent Controller ke paas application file karni hogi.

quality_tests.question: FIR kaise darj hoti hai?
quality_tests.expected_answer: FIR darj karne ke liye police station mein complaint file karni hoti hai. Aapko apni complaint likh kar police ko deni hogi.
quality_tests.reference_answer: FIR darj karne ke liye police station mein complaint file karni hoti hai. Aapko apni complaint likh kar police ko deni hogi.

quality_tests.question: Talaq ke baad mehr kaise mil sakta hai?
quality_tests.expected_answer: Talaq ke baad mehr ki raqam shohar ko deni hoti hai. Agar mehr ada nahi hua to court se recovery kar sakte hain.
quality_tests.reference_answer: Talaq ke baad mehr ki raqam shohar ko deni hoti hai. Agar mehr ada nahi hua to court se recovery kar sakte hain.
